capstones.name: Resplendent Glory
capstones.effect: For 2 minutes, +25% mitigation, heal for 10% of damage taken. Glow with glory.
capstones.description: The warrior shines with resplendent glory, turning pain into strength.

capstones.name: Divine Guardian
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, group takes -20% damage. Paladin takes +10% damage (the guardian's burden).
capstones.description: The paladin becomes the group's divine guardian.

capstones.name: Leech Touch
capstones.effect: Instant lifetap: deal 800 + (level × 8) damage, heal for 150% of damage dealt.
capstones.description: An evolved Harm Touch that drinks the victim's life.

mechanics.notes: Instant lifetap; heal is 150% of damage actually dealt.

capstones.name: Five Point Palm
capstones.effect: Special attack: 5 rapid strikes, each with +50% damage. If all hit, target is stunned for 6 seconds.
capstones.description: The legendary five point palm exploding heart technique.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Five Point Palm (damage author). Stun only if all 5 strikes hit.

capstones.name: Twisted Chance Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, positional damage (backstab) +50%, chance to double backstab +15%.
capstones.description: The rogue twists chance itself for the perfect strike.

capstones.name: Savage Spirit
capstones.effect: For 3 minutes, +25% sustained damage, +15% attack speed. No HP requirement.
capstones.description: The savage spirit sustains the berserker's fury.

capstones.name: Imbued Ferocity
capstones.effect: Self buff (5 min): +30% ranged damage, +25% melee damage, +10% crit.
capstones.description: The ranger is imbued with primal ferocity.

capstones.name: Attack of the Warders
capstones.effect: Summon 3 spirit warder duplicates for 1 minute. Each deals 50% of warder damage.
capstones.description: The warder's spirit multiplies into a pack.

mechanics.description: Summons 3 spirit warder duplicates for 1 minute. Each deals 50% of warder damage.

capstones.name: Funeral Dirge
capstones.effect: Debuff target (2 min): takes +25% damage from all sources. Cannot be resisted.
capstones.description: The bard sings the enemy's funeral dirge.

capstones.name: Unfailing Divinity
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, the cleric's heals have 30% chance to trigger a free duplicate heal.
capstones.description: Divinity ensures the cleric's healing never fails.

capstones.name: Season's Wrath
capstones.effect: Debuff target: -30 cold/fire resist, takes +20% cold/fire damage for 30 rounds.
capstones.description: The wrath of the seasons strips the enemy's resistance.

capstones.name: Ancestral Aid
capstones.effect: Instant emergency heal for 1500 + cure all effects on target. Can be cast while stunned.
capstones.description: The ancestors answer the shaman's desperate call.

mechanics.notes: Usable while stunned. Heal 1500 — heal author.

capstones.name: Veil of Mindshadow
capstones.effect: Self buff (2 min): 50% chance to memblur attacker on hit. +500 rune (damage absorb).
capstones.description: The enchanter shrouds themselves in mindshadow.

capstones.name: Frenzied Burnout
capstones.effect: For 15 rounds, pet damage +60%, pet attack speed +30%. Pet takes +20% damage.
capstones.description: The elemental burns with frenzied power.

capstones.name: Hand of Death
capstones.effect: Lifetap nuke: 1000 + (level × 10) damage, heal for 100% of damage. Unresistable.
capstones.description: Death's own hand reaches out to claim life.

capstones.name: Improved Twincast
capstones.effect: For 60 seconds, 25% chance for nukes to cast twice (second at 50% damage, no mana cost).
capstones.description: The wizard's spells echo with twincast power.

mechanics.description: For 60 seconds, 25% chance for nukes to cast twice (second at 50% damage, no mana cost).
